label: MRtrix3 warpinit
description:
Create an initial warp image, representing an identity transformation
This is useful to obtain the warp fields from other normalisation applications, by applying the transformation of interest to the warp field generated by this program.
The image generated is a 4D image with the same spatial characteristics as the input template image. It contains 3 volumes, with each voxel containing its own x,y,z coordinates.
Note that this command can be used to create 3 separate X,Y,Z images directly (which may be useful to create images suitable for use in the registration program) using the following syntax:
  $ warpinit template.mif warp-'[]'.nii

parameters.label: quiet
parameters.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).

output_slots.label: warp
output_slots.description: the output warp image. The output meaning depends on the input and selected operation. This generic image port does not certify anatomical labels, diffusion orientation, tissue fractions or spatial alignment.
